Order 
This first Criminal appeal filed under Section 14-A of the Scheduled Castes & Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 for grant of bail on behalf of the appellant is arising out of order dated 13.06.2024 passed by Special Judge (Atrocities), Narsinghpur in connection with F.I.R./Crime No.57/2024 dated 03.04.2024 registered at Police Station Dongargaon, District Narsinghpur for the offences punishable under Sections 376-D, 294, 323/34 and 506-II of IPC and Sections 3(1)(w)(i), 3(2)(v), 3(1)
(r), 3(1)(s) and 3(2)(va) of Scheduled Castes & Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act.

entities.text: Scheduled Castes & Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
The appellant is in custody since 05.04.2024.
2.
Learned counsel for the appellant contends that on a First Information Report lodged by the complainant, the appellant is being prosecuted for the aforesaid offences.
It is contended by the counsel that the appellant has not committed any offence and has been falsely implicated in this case.

It is contended by the counsel that the prosecutrix is major though 2 CRA-8102-2024 she alleged that she was subjected to commission of offence of rape in jungle but upon examination,
neither any external nor any internal injury was found by the doctor.

It is evident from perusal of her statement recorded under Section 161 of Cr.P.C. that she went along with the present appellant- Dhananjay on her own free will and later on according to the prosecution, present appellant had persuaded the co-accused-Pandit to commit the rape upon the prosecutix who has already been enlarged on bail by this Court on 02/08/2024 in Cr.A.no.7211/2024.

It is contended by the counsel that the allegations are unsustainable and the statements of prosecutrix recorded under Sections 161 and 164 of Cr.P.C. goes contrary to each other and contain material contradiction despite the fact Dhananjay @ Chhotu vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/75007251/
1 that same were recorded on the same day.

sentences.text: Therefore, submits that the appellant deserves to be enlarged on bail inasmuch as he is suffering incarceration since 05.04.2024.
3. Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent-State contends that the present appeal for bail deserves to be dismissed.

It is contended by the counsel that upon persuasion of present appellant only, co-accused has committed the aforesaid offences and therefore, taking into consideration the role of the appellant, the appeal for grant of bail is not made out.
4.
Heard rival submissions of both the parties and perused the case diary.
5. On perusal of the case diary, it is evident that the appellant in connection with the aforesaid offences, was taken into custody on 05.04.2024.

The statement of the prosecutrix reflects that she went along with the present appellant and co-accused on her own free will and later on, 3 CRA-8102-2024 present appellant - Dhananjay persuaded the co-accused - Pandit to commit rape upon the prosecutrix who has already been enlarged on bail by this Court on 02/08/2024 in Cr.A.no.7211/2024.
Undisputedly no external or internal injury was found upon the body of the prosecutrix and no definite opinion regarding commission of rape has been given by the doctor.

6. Thus, considering the over all circumstances and the facts of the case and also looking to the statement of the prosecutrix, this Court deems it to be a fit case to release the appellant on bail,
therefore, without commenting on the merit of the case, this appeal is allowed.

7. It is directed that appellant- Dhananjay @ Chhotu shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his regular appearance before said Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during pendency of trial.

8. It is directed that the appellant shall abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
(MANINDER S. BHATTI) JUDGE Astha Dhananjay @ Chhotu vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/75007251/
